text:
Which statement about amphoteric oxides is correct?
A
They are made by combining an acidic oxide with a basic oxide.
B
They react with water to give a solution of pH7.
C
They react with both acids and bases.
D
They do not react with acids or bases.

options.label: A
options.text: They are made by combining an acidic oxide with a basic oxide.

options.label: B
options.text: They react with water to give a solution of pH7.

options.label: C
options.text: They react with both acids and bases.

options.label: D
options.text: They do not react with acids or bases.
